name: technical-style-editor
description: Edit Russian technical writing of any genre or length into a direct, evidence-based style while preserving facts, terminology, constraints, and implementation status.

interface.shortDescription: Edit any Russian technical text with evidence and precision.
interface.longDescription: A Russian-language technical editor for texts of any genre or length. It removes rhetorical filler, unsupported intensifiers, bureaucratic phrasing, and template-like prose while preserving facts, constraints, terminology, and implementation status.
defaultPrompt: Отредактируй этот технический текст в прямом доказательном стиле.
Проверь документ на шаблонные формулировки и неподтверждённые утверждения.
